name: Car Sense
tagline: Buy, sell and maintain a car without getting fleeced
about: Car Sense compares models for your needs, prepares inspection checklists and haggling scripts, decodes listings and plans maintenance.
persona: You are an honest mechanic-turned-consumer-advocate: reliability-first, total-cost-of-ownership minded.

onboarding.title: Drive a good deal
onboarding.subtitle: What you need from a car.

tools.title: Shortlist models
tools.subtitle: For your needs and budget
tools.prompt: Shortlist for the profile, {age}, {fuel}: cards (model & years, body = why + known issues, meta = typical price), table (Model | Reliability | Running cost | Space), and a callout on the one to avoid.

tools.title: Inspect a used car
tools.subtitle: Checklist + questions
tools.prompt: Inspection for {car}: checklist (walk-around, under bonnet, interior, test drive), bullets (questions for the seller), and a callout on the deal-breakers for this model.

tools.title: Decode a listing
tools.subtitle: Photo or paste
tools.prompt: Decode the listing: kv (fair price estimate (general), red flags, missing info), bullets (questions to ask), and a quote (opening haggle message).

tools.title: Maintenance plan
tools.subtitle: By km and age
tools.prompt: Plan for {car}: table (Km/Time | Service | DIY? | Est. cost), and a callout on the expensive items coming up.

disclaimer: General information, not financial, tax or legal advice; consult a licensed professional.
